te: Social Security Office heard on the CARE pension formula
se: The meeting invited the Social Security Office to give information on the change to the formula for calculating the old-age pensions of insured persons under sections 33 and 39, known as the CARE formula, which uses average earnings over the whole period of contributions instead of the average wage of the last 60 months, to make pensions fairer
it: Change to the old-age pension formula (the CARE formula)

te: Report on foreign workers followed up, and a seminar on Thai workers approved
se: The meeting noted progress on the draft report on the study of the motion on foreign workers, with Samut Sakhon Province as a case study. It approved holding a seminar on "Thai Workers amid Change" with the House of Representatives Committee on Labour on 1–2 November 2025, and approved the draft report on the concept of a National Labour Development Digital Platform (NLDD)
it: Draft report on the study of the motion on foreign workers
Seminar on Thai Workers amid Change (1–2 November 2025)
Progress of the subcommittees' work followed up

te: Annual report for 2025 approved, and labour shortages discussed
se: The meeting approved the draft report on its work for fiscal year 2025 for submission to the Senate, agreed to send its proposal on a reception centre for foreign workers to the Ministry of Interior and the Ministry of Labour, and discussed ways to solve labour shortages after Cambodian workers returned home, including making visa extensions convenient at a single point
it: Report on work, fiscal year 2025
Proposal on a reception centre for foreign workers
Labour shortages and visa extensions

te: Study begins on 2 draft labour protection laws
se: The meeting considered 2 draft Labour Protection Acts accepted in principle by the House of Representatives, under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure: one on working hours, holidays and annual leave, and the other on equality in employment, menstrual leave, leave to care for family members and breastfeeding spaces at work. It assigned the Subcommittee on Labour Welfare and Protection to study them
it: 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... (Senate Rules of Procedure, rule 119)
Progress of the subcommittees' work followed up

te: Department of Employment heard on sending workers to train in Japan
se: The meeting invited the Department of Employment to give information for the bilateral meeting and visit to Japan (9–14 November 2025) on sending Thai workers for technical intern training. Most of those who go return and do well in their occupations, but applications to the IM Japan programme have fallen because trainees lack income during training
it: The bilateral meeting and visit to Japan (9–14 November 2025)

te: Visit to Japan prepared, and a framework for the committee's budget set
se: The meeting heard information in preparation for the bilateral meeting and visit to Japan (9–14 November 2025), resolved that the petitioner in a petition from state nurses be informed of the outcome of its consideration, and considered a framework for managing the budget of the committee and its subcommittees in proportion to their tasks
it: The bilateral meeting and visit to Japan (9–14 November 2025)
Petition on the pay of state nurses
Framework for managing the committee's budget

te: Visit to Japan prepared: the IM Japan programme heard
se: The meeting invited the Department of Skill Development to give information for the bilateral meeting and visit to Japan (9–14 November 2025). The IM Japan programme has sent Thai workers for technical training since 2000, with more than 6,000 participants so far, and there were proposals to raise the quality of training
it: The bilateral meeting and visit to Japan (9–14 November 2025)

te: Results of the skills development study visit to Rayong and Chon Buri noted
se: The meeting noted the results of the study visit to Rayong and Chon Buri Provinces on 3–4 September 2025, which studied skills development for energy and battery work and the electric vehicle industry, and the possibility of developing courses with educational institutions
it: Results of the study visit to Rayong and Chon Buri Provinces (3–4 September 2025)
Progress of the subcommittees' work followed up

te: Staff for 2026 confirmed and appointed, and an outline for the annual report set
se: The meeting confirmed that 22 advisers, experts, academics and secretaries of fiscal year 2025 will continue to serve in 2026, appointed 8 more, considered the outline of its annual summary of work, and followed up the work of its subcommittees
it: Appointment of persons to work for the committee, fiscal year 2026
Outline of the annual summary of work
Progress of the subcommittees' work followed up

te: Seminar on the Employee Welfare Fund prepared
se: The meeting noted the schedule of the seminar on "Developing the Employee Welfare Fund for Greater Security for Thai Workers" on 19 September 2025 at Parliament House, considered the appointment of persons to work for the committee, and followed up the work of its subcommittees
it: Seminar on developing the Employee Welfare Fund (19 September 2025)
Appointment of persons to work for the committee
Progress of the subcommittees' work followed up

te: Report on the visit to Norway and Sweden approved
se: The meeting approved the draft report on the bilateral meeting and visit to the Kingdom of Norway and the Kingdom of Sweden (21–28 June 2025), with recommendations on the risk of human trafficking in wild berry picking, work as Thai massage practitioners, and ageing societies, and resolved that it be printed and shared with agencies
it: Report on the bilateral meeting and visit to the Kingdom of Norway and the Kingdom of Sweden (21–28 June 2025)

te: Work on seafarers, riders and ILO conventions followed up
se: The meeting noted the work of its subcommittees, such as approaches to developing and sending Thai seafarers to the merchant shipping industry, the study visit to Rayong and Chon Buri, the study of protection for riders, and the draft report on ratifying International Labour Organization Conventions No. 87 and No. 98
it: Progress of the subcommittees' work followed up
Draft report on ratifying ILO Conventions No. 87 and No. 98

te: Senate debate on the draft labour protection law prepared
se: The meeting noted that the House of Representatives has approved the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. ...., and assigned Pol.Lt.Col. Suriya Barasun, Mr. Chinnachot Saengsank and Mrs. Nongluk Kankhiao to prepare for the debate when the draft reaches the Senate. It postponed the study visit and seminar in Trang Province, and followed up the work of its subcommittees
it: Draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. .... (as approved by the House of Representatives)
Study visit and seminar, Trang Province
Progress of the subcommittees' work followed up

te: Information heard on Thai workers still unable to return to work in Israel
se: The meeting considered a petition from Thai workers facing hardship because they are still unable to return to work in the State of Israel, inviting the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Labour to clarify. They stated that the suspension of sending workers remains in place for the workers' safety until the Ministry of Foreign Affairs announces a change
it: Petition concerning Thai workers still unable to return to work in the State of Israel

te: State nurses' petition referred on, and the Norway–Sweden visit summarised
se: The meeting considered a petition asking for labour law and the pay of state nurses to be improved. It referred the issue of benefits for public health personnel to the Committee on Public Health, assigned the Subcommittee on Social Security to study extending coverage, and resolved that a report on the bilateral meeting and visit to the Kingdom of Norway and the Kingdom of Sweden (21–28 June 2025) be prepared for the Senate and the agencies concerned
it: Petition on labour law and the pay of state nurses
Summary of the bilateral meeting and visit to the Kingdom of Norway and the Kingdom of Sweden (21–28 June 2025)
Progress of the subcommittees' work followed up

te: Schedule of the visit to Norway and Sweden noted
se: The meeting noted the schedule and discussion topics of the bilateral meeting and visit to the Kingdom of Norway and the Kingdom of Sweden (21–28 June 2025), at the embassies and with Thai associations, such as support for Thai workers, the problems Thai workers face, and skills development
it: The bilateral meeting and visit to the Kingdom of Norway and the Kingdom of Sweden (21–28 June 2025)
